gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Grandstander draws every letter with a ballpoint's pressure-free line, bold and expressive, with short ascenders. Noto Sans Tamil sits next to it looking magnified, its terminals stopping far from the stem, a modern counterpart.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tamil-s: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement draws round forms like open parentheses, with a middle band so tall the line looks stocky. Grandstander's identical bar thickness makes the loud part, and paragraphs beneath it should read steadily, clean and contemporary.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Noto Sans Tangsa gives round letters a wide, inviting opening, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Grandstander's bowls are drawn at stem thickness, so a paragraph in the sans-serif below should feel approachable and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC has large open counters in a, e and s, and curves that open outward rather than curling in. Grandstander's neon-tube thickness gives headings a glowing, expressive edge.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-telugu: A high-set midline and counters that stay connected to the outside make this body text read openly. Noto Sans Telugu does the quiet carrying, while Grandstander, g and all in one unchanging line weight, does the shouting.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, with rounded letters left open. Grandstander is best at a constant-weight hum that announces things, while the sans is best at being approachable.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-thai-lo: Bold-looking lowercase, thanks to tall bodies and spacious gaps at curve terminals, gives this text a clean feel. Noto Sans Thai Looped meets Grandstander's identical-weight strokes with sturdiness of its own, which is what binds them.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tifinag: Clean, rounded Noto Sans Tifinagh keeps letters open and inviting, its lowercase bowls filling the line like inflated shapes. And the stitched-thread plainness of Grandstander's strokes is the quality that lifts the whole pairing, bold above, soft below.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Grandstander's strokes have no thin or thick parts at all, just a plain, constant line with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Noto Sans Tirhuta, terminals cut back to leave big gaps, should read comfortably.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-noto-sans-ugariti: Approachable Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps x-height and cap height nearly level, its open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs. And Grandstander's wire-bent look carries the headline, while text in the plain sans should read smoothly.
